name: Hindi business call — classic deferral
transcript:
[00:00:05] Sharma: Namaste Ravi bhai. Aaj ki meeting mein aapka swagat hai.
[00:00:12] Ravi: Namaste Sharma ji. Aapka proposal padha. Bahut achha hai.
[00:00:18] Sharma: Toh kya aap agree karte hain is partnership ke liye?
[00:00:24] Ravi: Dekhte hain. Abhi confirm nahi kar sakta. Upar se baat karni padegi pehle.
[00:00:32] Sharma: Kab tak answer de sakte hain?
[00:00:38] Ravi: Kal pakka bata denge. Thoda time chahiye management se discuss karne ke liye. Yeh decision akele nahi le sakta.
[00:00:50] Sharma: Koi baat nahi. Main ek detailed proposal send kar deta hoon aaj shaam tak, jisse aapki meeting mein help ho.
[00:00:58] Ravi: Haan bilkul. Proposal bhej do. Main team ko dikhaunga aur phir decide karenge.
[00:01:08] Sharma: Theek hai. Main aaj shaam tak bhej deta hoon. Aur agar koi question ho toh call karo.
[00:01:15] Ravi: Zaroor. Sochenge aur aapko update denge.

summary: Ravi appreciated the proposal but cannot confirm without management approval.
Ravi promised an update the next day after discussing with the team.
Sharma will send a detailed proposal by evening to support the internal meeting.

action_items.task: Discuss with management and provide update
